cleanup: own temporary directory removed after all owners stopped

ack.boundary: Engine::answer(Ack) through durable receipt, one exact occurrence each; excludes token/guard construction and replay verification

fresh_open.boundary: Store::open plus Engine::open: create/initialize database, durable initial snapshot, zone/state validation; excludes scratch-directory creation

list_first_page.boundary: Engine::answer(List first page of at most 8 items), including current tick and view construction; excludes request construction and wire JSON

overdue_tick.boundary: one Engine::tick at authored +3600 seconds, including persisting all newly pending items

same_boot_reopen.boundary: Store::open plus Engine::open on the existing database, including recovery/integrity/state validation; excludes closing the previous owner

set.boundary: Engine::answer(Set), including validation, snapshot serialization, SQLite commit and directory sync; excludes request construction and wire JSON

notes: Choose a short scratch parent path for Unix socket limits.
A tmpfs or RAM-backed scratch parent does not qualify persistent storage.
First means first call of that operation after the setup described in its boundary, not whole-process cold start.
Filesystem syscalls can stall independently of bounded IPC/wait loops; this does not prove physical power-loss survival.
reference_target_boundary: healthy storage: complete valid request through durable response; target only, not a lamp guarantee

due_to_bus_receive.boundary: authored clock jump through worker scheduling (nominal 50 ms scan), pending commit, publish and subscriber receive (datagram or retained Latest); excludes subscription setup

set_roundtrip.boundary: Unix connect, request serialization/write, owner queue/validation/durable commit, reply read/parse/ok validation; excludes guard status request

status_beside_silent_client.boundary: one status Unix roundtrip after opening a second connection that sends nothing; excludes silent connect

status_roundtrip.boundary: Unix connect, status request write, owner reply read/parse/ok validation

time_basis.calendar: authored trusted UTC and authored same-boot elapsed clock; system clocks unchanged
time_basis.durations: real host Instant elapsed; filesystem and local IPC included as labelled
